propositions: Write operation parameters (force, reason, caused_by, ref, close_class) are hand-mirrored across three adapters (library, CLI, MCP) and can silently diverge without mechanical enforcement.

A transport-agnostic conformance oracle must execute a shared contract table through all three adapters against fresh temp stores and assert ACCEPTED/REJECTED consistency including runtime conditional rules (reason required for close, close_class required for bug-close).

Current MCP gaps (reason, caused_by, force not exposed on transition/claim in inputSchema) must be encoded as strict-xfail rows citing scratchy-leprous-galago so the suite is green in CI until that ticket lands and flips the xfails to xpass.

The transition coupled-force rows (force as str | None replacing legacy bool+separate_reason+force_close) are introduced by blusterous-earthly-kitten and must be encoded as strict-xfail citing that ticket to preserve oracle greenness in CI regardless of landing order.

Existing three-adapter harness (tests/interfaces/adapters.py) must be extended to thread force/reason/close_class/caused_by/ref parameters through Adapter protocol and its three implementations without rebuilding parallel drivers.
Adapter-bound internals (source, return_alias, _creation_channel, repo_root) must not register as false divergences in the conformance oracle.
